relationships.external_proposition: Verify restored-asset integrity, restore systems and services, and confirm normal operating status.
relationships.fc_property: The property by which an AI-mediated service or material dependent function fulfils independently established availability and usable-functional-quality obligations. When service is materially interrupted, degraded, restricted or withdrawn, the responsible actor must meet the applicable continuity standard through proportionate operation, usable degraded service, timely recovery, feasible alternative or informed transition within its authority and control. Accurate outage reporting or a merely nominal fallback does not, by itself, establish that the required service continuity was preserved.
relationships.invariant: An AI-mediated service must maintain the usable availability and functional quality required by its independently established obligations. If material interruption, degradation, restriction or withdrawal occurs, the responsible actor must preserve the required function or provide proportionate, feasible and practically usable degraded operation, recovery, alternative access or transition in accordance with those obligations. Neither ordinary service variation nor adverse outcomes alone establish a breach; a service obligation, material functional shortfall and insufficient governed response must be evidenced.
